name: Kushira (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kushira town emblem in red: an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Kushira in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01.

features.role: Kushira town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
